description: Accounts in Arabic script and eastern Arabic numerals. Dating: Late, probably Ottoman era. Mentions mainly Christian names: ʿAbd al-Masiḥ b. Yūshaʿ(?); Ṣalīb(?) the son of [...]; Yūsuf; Yūḥannā wa-ʿĪsā; Ilyās al-Bannāʾ. One of the headers seems to read "jawārī" and the term jāriya also appears on verso. Merits further examination.
